verdict.rationale: Segment's own Engage docs say marketers can build Audiences from tracking events (behavior), traits and computed traits, then sync them to hundreds of destinations, so the core audience-building and activation capability is documented. Nothing in the evidence shows the builder is visual or no-SQL, or that it shows an estimated audience size before activation. Missing for 10: evidence of a visual no-SQL builder, estimated audience size preview before activation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
